caption: The drawing depicts a decorative wrought iron railing and pillar, illustrated with brown and black ink on a beige background. The main portion on the left shows a rectangular section of the railing composed of spiraled and curved bars forming symmetrical patterns. The upper and lower borders of this section are adorned with repeating motifs of grape clusters and grapevine leaves, interlinked within the metalwork. Three ornamental posts with intricate scrolling shapes are positioned at the top. To the right, there are two vertical bands representing the design of supporting rail posts, also decorated with repeating clusters of grapes and vine leaves, arranged in an entwined, criss-cross lattice manner. Faint architectural outlines in the background suggest the presence of windows, walls, and possibly other segments of a building. The linework is highly detailed, emphasizing the botanical and organic themes throughout the ironwork. The entire composition is bordered with a thin rectangular line, setting it apart from the plain, unadorned paper surrounding the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
